findings.quote: Capital spending at investment-grade borrowers grew 65% from a year earlier in the second quarter
findings.why: Goldman's Global Strategy Views ties the 65% Q2 year-over-year capex growth specifically to AA-rated issuers, not to investment-grade borrowers as a whole.

findings.quote: is buying October options rather than chasing the price
findings.why: In context Nomura's October vol/convexity position is long equity downside hedges (and October calls on INTC/MRVL/SNDK/MU), while the 'buy call spreads rather than chase spot' oil call belongs to The Market Ear, so the crude-paragraph framing credits Nomura with something the context does not contain.
findings.fix: Attribute the call-spread-over-spot oil expression to The Market Ear, and describe Nomura's October options as equity downside hedges.
